ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Deletes the traceability-manifest gate + regen-PR job, the pinned third-party shipwright-compliance checkout they used, and the contents:write/pull-requests:write carve-out scoped only to the regen-PR job. Every remaining job stays read-only under the top-level contents:read permission; no new credential, PAT, or write scope is introduced. GitHub-owned actions stay on mutable tags and third-party actions stay SHA-pinned per CLAUDE.md rule 25 — unaffected by this change.
